turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    subgraph ASSAY["ASSAY — read-only"]
        C[Run floor nouns against document]
        D[Compress to residue]
        E[Report residue, evaporation, operative sentence, and finding]
        F[End with fixed closing string]
        C --> D --> E --> F
    end

    subgraph PROVIDE["PROVIDE — negotiation side"]
        G{Mode stated or inferable?}
        H[Ask for mode]
        I{Floor check}
        J[Ask up to three questions]
        K[Wait for answers]
        L[Compress the prompt]
        M{Cut removed specification?}
        N[Name failure and revert]
        O{Two empty cuts in succession?}
        P[Contract is minimal]
        Q{Floor still passes?}
        R[Return last passing version]
        S[Output contract]
        G -- no --> H --> I
        G -- yes --> I
        I -- gaps --> J --> K --> I
        I -- passes --> L --> M
        M -- yes --> N --> L
        M -- no --> O
        O -- yes --> P --> S
        O -- no --> Q
        Q -- no --> R --> P
        Q -- yes --> P
    end

    A --> B
    B -- received document --> C
    B -- draft prompt --> G
    S --> T{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    T -- keep negotiating --> L
    T -- freeze, execute, or run it --> U{Execution tools available?}
    U -- no --> V[Gate stays closed]
    U -- yes --> W[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    W --> X{Result}
    X -- success --> Y[Done]
    X -- floor failure --> Z[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    Z --> L
```
